sleeping_bag.name: AERIAL 180
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight down sleeping bag with specialized construction
sleeping_bag.description: Aerial 180 is presented as a minimal false-bottom sleeping bag designed to minimize weight while maximizing useful insulation through specialized construction, no zipper, and no hood.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 300 g total weight
- 180 g of 900 FP down
- Comfort 4 C / limit 0 C
- Stitched-through chamber design
- False-bottom construction
- No zipper
- No hood according to official product snippet
- Simple mattress attachment system
- Stuffsack and storage sack included
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents Aerial 180 as a top ultralight choice for discerning adventurers who analyze every gram and want specialized performance in lightweight pursuits.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Extreme adventure pursuits, long-distance cycling races, technical multi-day hikes, lightweight-focused adventures.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User-provided France capture shows 279 EUR, while indexed official Cumulus snippets from older crawls showed 275 EUR.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
sleeping_bag.current_status: current model listed on France category capture and official product snippets
